data.name: Mudhakkar
data.gender_notes: Mudhakkar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is preoccupied with the past and the remembrance of Allah. The name Mudhakkar carries the meaning “Remembrer, Reflector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mudhakkar usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrer, reflector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is deeply contemplative and reflective, always thinking of Allah and seeking His guidance
data.etymology: Mudhakkar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrer, Reflector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mudhakkar total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مذكّر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مذكر مشتق من الذكرى والذكر في القرآن الكريم
in_arabic.long_meaning: مذكّر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة ذكرى والذكر في القرآن الكريم، ويعني الشخص الذي يذكر الله كثيرًا، ويُذكر في القرآن الكريم كصفة للمتقين في سورة آل عمران الآية 191، وفي سورة الحج الآية 41، وله أهمية كبيرة في التعبير عن الإيمان والتوكل على الله

in_urdu.name: مذکر
in_urdu.meaning: مذکر نام کا مطلب ہے ذکر کرنے والا، اللہ کو یاد کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مذکر ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا مذکر نام ہے، جو ذکر اور ذِکر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں وہ شخص جو اللہ کو بہت یاد کرتا ہے، قرآن کریم میں مذکر کی اہمیت بیان کی گئی ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ آل عمران میں، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں اہم ثقافتی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: मुज़क्कर
in_hindi.meaning: मुज़क्कर का अर्थ है अल्लाह को याद करने वाला, ذكر करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुज़क्कर एक अरबी मूल का नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो अल्लाह को बहुत याद करता है, यह नाम कुरआन से प्रेरित है, विशेष रूप से सूरह آل عمران और सूरह हज में, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है

in_english.name: Mudhakkar
in_english.meaning: One who remembers Allah, recalls divine
in_english.long_meaning: Mudhakkar is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the words 'ذِكر' (zikr) and 'مُذَكّر' (mudhakkar), signifying one who frequently remembers or mentions Allah, referenced in the Quran, particularly in Surah Al-Imran (3:191) and Surah Al-Haj (22:41), embodying a spiritual significance in Islamic tradition for individuals devoted to remembrance and invocation of the Divine, reflecting virtues of piety and mindfulness

data.cultural_impact: The name Mudhakkar can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic emphasis onhistory, tradition, and the significance of remembering past events, particularly those related to the life of the Prophet Muhammad and Islamic history. The name can also be linked to the concept of taaruf, or getting to know someone, as it suggests a deep and profound reflection on one's own past and relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Mudhakkar reflects the concept of dhikr, or remembrance of Allah. The one who is Mudhakkar is constantly preoccupied with the remembrance of Allah and the past, which can be seen as a form of devotion and a means of close connection with the divine. The name can also be linked to the Islamic concept of the Day of Judgment, where each person will be called to account for their actions in the past. Thus, the name Mudhakkar can be seen as a reminder to focus on the past in order to learn from it and to prepare for the future and the judgment of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Remembrer, Reflector" symbolizes One who is preoccupied with the past and the remembrance of Allah.
